description.narrative: The Government of Malawi is requesting additional financing in the amount of US$27.7 million from its Twelfth Replenishment of IFAD¿s Resources (IFAD12) allocation, with a two-year extension, moving PRIDE¿s completion date to 31 December 2026. The objectives of the proposed additional financing are to fill a financing gap unforeseen at design, arising from higher irrigation infrastructure costs, and to scale up successful interventions.
